A fifth tab in the footer, a bell, between Wallet and Profile, with a dot when something is unread. It opens a plain list. The tab is active (filled) on the list page. This changes the four tabs the app has today (For You, Your Songs, Wallet, Profile); the /activity page that would hold it is a placeholder that says notifications are unavailable. On desktop it is a fifth sidebar link between Wallet and Profile, and the same list fills the main column. Every footer and sidebar on the Screens page shows the tab, and since 2026-10-12 so do the footer masters on the Patterns and Parts pages (Patterns/Navigation/MobileFooterNav, Parts/Shell/AppShellChrome): five destinations everywhere.
For now the list holds only the answers to things the person submitted: a dance passed, did not pass, or was not reviewed within seven days, and a video that could not be posted or did not meet the guidelines. Each row is the answer and its age, nothing more, per the workspace_owner. Tapping a row opens what it is about: a dance answer opens its result page (Parts/Rewards/ActivityResult), which names the song and has passed, not-passed and not-reviewed states; a failed video opens a fresh composer on the same song. The not-reviewed row has a neutral mark, because it is not a fail.
The one-time notice on Home for a failed video, which Spec 024 ratifies, becomes a row here so it cannot be lost.
With nothing to show the page says "Nothing yet." and no more.
Design change from the code: the tab, the sidebar link and the list are new, and need a notifications read from the API that does not exist yet.
Not drawn yet: on desktop, the not-reviewed row and the empty page, both drawn on the phone only; any other kind of notification; loading and a failed read. The unread dot is drawn on the desktop sidebars (not the signed-out one), on the phone Home screen of this sheet and on Parts/Identity/YourProfiles; the other phone footers show the bell without it.
Source: shell navigation model; features/posts/video-outcomes; Spec 024.
